entries.contract: Create an aligned component design sheet, not an application screenshot with all states shown at once. Ref1 existing ASK leaks internal metadata below Yes: eliminate that leakage in the proposed UI. Design the Results island for four mutually exclusive states: ASK true with an outline check icon and “Yes”; ASK false with a neutral outline minus icon and “No” (false is a successful answer, not an error); empty tuple results with header, normal download/result controls where supported and calm “No results” inset; query execution error with outline alert icon, restrained rose error title and full wrap-safe error message with technical details disclosure when long. Add small mobile versions showing same toolbar wrapping, not disappearing. Also show compact running with Cancel and cancelled feedback specimens. Do not invent retry buttons, telemetry, elapsed times, row counts or successful summaries not provided by backend. Never display request UUIDs or metadata as stray text. Same white12px island, slate text, teal icons for success and URI data, restrained rose only actualerror. Desktop toolbar one row, mobile two. No default horizontal scrollbar. An empty dataset must be explicit, without a blank tall editor or fabricated row.
entries.prompt: Create a precise high-fidelity RDF4J Workbench page design board with a large desktop page at left and a narrow 390px mobile rendition at right. Reference1 is this exact existing page for real fields/data/actions; reference2 is the approved new design visual language. Preserve functional labels and workflows from reference1, but replace its grey gradient, orange rule, tiny native widgets, cobalt links and fixed mobile sidebar. Use slate #f1f5f9 canvas, white islands radius12 with subtle soft shadows, #f8fafc inset sections, #0f172a titles, #334155 navigation/secondary actions, #64748b muted text, #e2e8f0 dividers, #cbd5e1 controls. Teal #0f766e primary actions and content URI links; no blue links anywhere. Orange only in original RDF4J logo. Header small logo at left, readable server/repository/user context at right; slate Change links. Sidebar200px white island with consistent18px outline icons and selected page slate fill/left rule, main area flexible with24px gap/gutters. UI font14px, page title24px, island title16px. Labelled inputs/selects above fields,36px desktop44px mobile controls,8px radius,16px outline action icons. Mobile header context wraps, Menu disclosure closed above title, fullwidth fields stacked,16px gutters, no clipped text or horizontal page scrollbar. No phone frames, no decorative art, no invented features/statistics/confirmation steps. Treat all pages as ONE consistent application. Desktop page should use space proportionate to task: short forms cap field width around600px, tables use full available width; avoid enormous empty white cards. Retain real footer.  Mobile must use the approved mobile reference literally: context stays readable below logo, a separate labelled Menu disclosure row sits below header and above page title; do NOT replace it with a tiny unlabelled hamburger in the header. Use the same shell on every page. Change/submit action must sit OUTSIDE any optional disclosure, so usable when closed. entries.contract: Create a focused Results component design board for graph and tuple data, with desktop and mobile specimens. References show the existing graph result structure and approved embedded layout. Include populated graph triples using valid IRI subject <https://example.org/items/1>, predicate rdf:label, object “Example”; a second record with a deliberately long full URI and multiline literal. Use shared Results header and aligned Download, Result options, Full screen controls with outline icons. Use Auto layout default: readable fitted table on desktop, labelled complete records on mobile or overcrowded columns. Do not truncate terms or hide columns; preserve URI links in teal and literals slate. Show Result options open inset with Layout select Auto/Table/Records and Wrap values checkbox checked, page size and existing datatype preference if applicable; all fields stacked on mobile. Preserve pagination compactfooter. Also one small Full screen mobile specimen using all width and clear Exit full screen control. Render controls only once per specimen, no sidebar within a frame, no duplicated sample chrome. The same component can appear embedded or on direct result routes; the outside Workbench shell is unchanged. Explicit Table with Wrap off is the only deliberate horizontal scrolling mode.
